_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Kayam ti Player {player_id}, agpaspasulong iti {num_rounds} rounds ti Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Ket addaka ti ${pool} a mapan iti daytoy a round between yo ken ti Player {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Agpartuat iti maysa nga offer: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - No maaprobado → Makagatang ka iti $(pool - X), ti sabali a player ket makagatang iti $X
  - No maikkat → Adu a makagatang iti $0
  - Kasisal: [Offer: $3]  wenno  'Maysa ak iti nakikita a daytoy ket patas. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Desisyonan yo iti offer iti maysa a [Accept] wenno [Reject]
  - Kasisal: 'Daytoy ket narigat a makita. [Accept]'
            'Narigat a patta. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Round {round_number} umuna! ---
Ti Player {proposer_id} ket ti proposer, ti Player {responder_id} ket ti responder.
round.offer: Round {round_number}: Ti Player {proposer_id} ket inoffer iti ${offer} ken ti Player {responder_id} (nangateddeng iti ${keep}).
round.accepted: Inaproban ni Player {responder_id}! Round {round_number} ganansia: Player {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Player {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Baro a dagup: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Player {responder_id} rejected the offer! Round {round_number} gains: Both players +$0. Totals remain: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Ti proponente ket masapul a mangaramid ti maysa nga offer babaen iti panagusar ti pormat [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Ti kantidad ti naited a gatad ket nasken nga agbalin a balido a numero.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ti naited a gatad ket masapul nga agdagup iti $0 ken ${pool}.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Ti respondeur ket mabalin a [Accept] wenno [Reject] ti offer.

outcome.win: Nangabak ti Player {winner} iti ${winner_total} total vs ${loser_total} ni Player {loser}.
outcome.draw: Agpada a naggigiddan ti dua nga aggay-ayam iti ${total}.
